Key concepts

  • Freedom fighter nicknames = top 5% of all SSC questions.
  • City nicknames = top 5% of all SSC questions.
  • Tip: remember the city AND its state together.

2024–2025 Updates (high-yield additions)

  • Chandrababu Naidu — returned as AP CM in 2024 (TDP). Already a familiar name in SSC for "IT Tsunami" / "technocrat CM of AP".
  • N. Chandrababu Naidu — also widely called the "CEO Chief Minister" of India (for Hyderabad's IT growth).
  • Mohan Charan Majhi (Odisha CM from 2024) — first BJP CM of Odisha.
  • Devendra Fadnavis (Maharashtra CM from 2024) — referred to in media as the "Chanakya of Maharashtra politics" (informal).
  • Vande Bharat Express (Indian Railways) — branded as the "semi-high-speed train" of India. By 2024–25, 50+ Vande Bharat routes operational.
  • India's G20 Presidency (2023) — PM Modi chaired G20; New Delhi declaration adopted. India was often referred to as the "Vishwaguru" in media.
  • Paris Olympics 2024 — Neeraj Chopra (gold 2020 + silver 2024) became known as the "Golden Boy" of Indian athletics.
  • Vinesh Phogat (wrestler) — well-known for leading the 2023 wrestlers' protest; reached the 2024 Paris Olympic final.
  • B. Sudershan Reddy / M. Ramachandran etc. — verify any new Vice-Presidential/Presidential-candidate nicknames in 2025 elections.
Tip: City/freedom-fighter nicknames rarely change; for SSC focus is on the canonical list above. New additions (e.g., "Golden Boy" for Neeraj) are bonus marks.
